player_prompt.intro:
Wòle Agbala {player_id} le Indian Poker ŋuti.
- 52-katá dzɔdzɔ; wòle kpɔmɔ agbala bubu katá.
- Ante {ante} chip(s) ɖeɖeɖe, {max_rounds} ɖeɖeɖe kple.
- Mɔdɔdziwo: '[check]'  |  '[bet X]'  |  '[call]'  |  '[raise X]'  |  '[fold]'  (X nye integer kple ƒe ƒu ƒe wòle chipwo.)
- Katá gãwo ɖu akaté le gbɔgbalɛ.

round.announce:
### Eme {current_round}/{max_rounds}
Aka ƒe ŋku ɖe eme ƒe kaɖi nye: {card}

invalid_move.ambiguous: Nyaa kuɖe akɔnta gbɛgbɛɖeɖe, e.g. '[check]', '[bet 2]', '[call]', '[raise 3]', kple '[fold]'.
invalid_move.amount_min: Ele be ga si woƒle la nanye 1 alo esi wu nenema.
invalid_move.nothing_to_call: Naneke meli nàyɔ o; àte ŋu [check] boŋ.
invalid_move.no_bet_to_raise: Zã [bet X] nàʋu; womate ŋu ado ga o.
invalid_move.insufficient: Miele asitsanuɖuɖu si ade na dɔ sia wɔwɔ o.

board.possible_actions: Wò afɔɖeɖe siwo nàte ŋu aɖe: {legal}

message.showdown_tie: Gbɔgbalɛ ma: wòwo katá {card}. Akaté si – wòwo la {split}.
